name: Liquid-Cooled Hydraulic Power Unit PHEU
full_description: The Liquid-Cooled Hydraulic Power Unit PHEU is a customized primary hydraulic distribution system for liquid cooling applications. Accessen integrates plate heat exchangers, coolant pumps, water treatment systems, piping and valves, and electrical and control systems into a modular package designed to improve thermal efficiency and simplify operation for liquid-cooled data centers.

technical_parameters.Secondary Side Coolant: Deionized Water, Glycol, Propylene Glycol, Fluorinated Fluids

details.title: What is included in the PHEU module?
details.content: Accessen states that the PHEU integrates plate heat exchangers, coolant pumps, water treatment systems, piping, valves, and electrical and control systems into one primary hydraulic distribution module.

details.title: How does it improve project delivery?
details.content: The system uses prefabricated modules, precision jig alignment, and prefabricated piping so that field work only requires threaded or flanged connections, reducing installation time and on-site welding.

seo_data.meta_description: Modular liquid-cooled hydraulic power unit integrating PHE, pumps, and water treatment systems for data center liquid cooling infrastructure.
